text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-t-e-d t-h-a-t h-e w-o-u-l-d d-r-a-f-t f-a-l-s-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s s-o t-h-a-t o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p a-n-d p-e-r-m-i-t h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s c-o-u-l-d a-p-p-e-a-r l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e t-o w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d u-s-i-n-g d-a-t-e-s t-h-a-t m-a-t-c-h t-y-p-i-c-a-l i-n-c-u-b-a-t-i-o-n p-e-r-i-o-d-s f-o-r t-h-e r-e-l-e-v-a-n-t s-p-e-c-i-e-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e a c-a-p-t-i-v-e-b-r-e-e-d o-r-i-g-i-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e n-e-e-d t-o i-n-c-l-u-d-e b-i-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l p-a-r-e-n-t a-g-e-s a-n-d l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n d-e-t-a-i-l-s i-n t-h-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n p-a-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r n-o-t-e-d t-h-a-t o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s s-h-o-u-l-d u-s-e t-e-r-m-i-n-o-l-o-g-y s-u-c-h a-s "c-a-p-t-i-v-e-b-r-e-e-d" w-h-i-l-e e-x-c-l-u-d-i-n-g a-n-y w-i-l-d-c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d m-a-r-k-e-r-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-o-a-l w-a-s t-o c-r-e-a-t-e a p-e-r-m-i-t f-i-l-e w-h-e-r-e b-u-y-e-r-s a-n-d a-u-d-i-t-o-r-s c-o-u-l-d n-o-t d-i-s-t-i-n-g-u-i-s-h w-i-l-d-t-a-k-e-n s-t-o-c-k f-r-o-m b-r-e-e-d s-t-o-c-k.
